 Your calendar might mark Nov. 27 as Black Friday, but the reality is that retailers treat the entire month like a discount event. Sales for major gaming products are staggered throughout the month, as evidenced by Amazon's self-described early Black Friday deals. The online retailer has earmarked a wide range of games for every taste in these deals, from recent action titles to critical darlings and everything in between.

 Add as Preferred Source

 There's probably something for you here, regardless of platform — Amazon has included deals for games on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. Some highlights include:
 Control Resonant for PS5 and Xbox: $49.99 (17% off)
 Alan Wake 2 Deluxe Edition for PS5 and Xbox: $29.99 (25% off)
 Scott Pilgrim EX for PS5 and Switch: $24.99 (33% off)
 Lies of P for PS5: $38.99 (22% off)
 Mafia: The Old Country for PS5 and Xbox: $19.97 (33% off)
 The Rogue Prince of Persia : $19.99 (33% off) on PS5 and Switch; $24.99 (17% off) on Switch 2. There's also the enhanced Immortal Edition for $24.99 on Switch 2 that comes with exclusive art and packaging.
 Split Fiction for PS5 and Xbox Series X: $29.99 (40% off)
 Marvel Cosmic Invasion Deluxe Edition on Switch, PS5, and Xbox : $44.99 (25% off); $54.99 (21% off) on Switch 2
 Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition on PS5: $39.99 (20% off)
 Ball x Pit for Switch and PS5: $19.99 (33% off)
 Cult of the Lamb: Definitive Edition on Switch and PS5: $39.99 (33% off)
 Hello Kitty Island Adventure on Switch and PS5 : $19.99 (33% off)
 Dragon Quest 1 and 2 HD-2D Remake for PS5 : $38.99 (35% off)
 You can check out the full list of early Amazon gaming Black Friday deals here . Alternatively, you might be interested in learning about Nintendo's early hardware and software Black Friday deals , or PlayStation's BF deals on games and hardware . Walmart and Target are also offering some must-see deals on the Pokémon Trading Card Game. And stay tuned: based on the naming, it sounds like Amazon has more gaming deals coming down the pike.
